description:
Who we are
JustWatch delivers data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment business. From the biggest blockbusters to award-winning shows, major sporting events, and best-selling console games. From a small startup, we've evolved into a 200+ strong team, based in Berlin, around the world, or working remotely. We've been all about building a profitable business while riding that wave of impressive growth.

We are a research-driven team focused on delivering high-quality survey insights powered by machine learning models. To support our Lead Data Scientist, we are looking for a motivated and curious Working Student in Data Science who enjoys solving real-world problems, working with imperfect data, and continuously challenging themselves.

In this role, you will help monitor and improve our research models, ensure output quality aligns with benchmarks and industry trends, and contribute to exciting analytical projects such as box office prediction, audience analytics, and large-scale data mining initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for a student who wants hands-on experience in applied data science within a fast-paced and collaborative environment.


What you will be doing

  • Monitor day-to-day performance and output quality of research and machine learning models

  • Validate survey results against internal benchmarks and industry trends

  • Identify anomalies, inconsistencies, and opportunities for model improvement

  • Support data mining and exploratory analysis projects

  • Contribute to predictive analytics initiatives, including box office forecasting

  • Work closely with the Lead Data Scientist on operational and strategic data tasks

  • Help maintain and improve data workflows and pipelines

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure reliable and actionable insights


    • What we need from you

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field in Berlin. If you are not a student in Berlin, your application will be rejected immediately.

  • A result-driven, pragmatic mindset and the ability to work with imperfect or messy datasets

  • Hands-on mentality with a delivery- and service-oriented attitude

  • Strong analytical thinking and curiosity to challenge assumptions and improve processes

  • First experience with Snowflake, dbt, and/or Airflow

  • Passion for movies and TV shows

  • Good English communication skills

  • Constant learning, delivering results and creating value are the core characteristics of everyone at JustWatch and we are looking for these values in every person we are hiring.

    • What we offer you

  • Hands-on experience with real-world machine learning and research applications

  • Exposure to modern data stack technologies and scalable data workflows

  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful predictive analytics projects

  • A collaborative team environment with room to learn and grow

  • Flexible working conditions tailored to student schedules

    • Media is important to us, and we are always happy to hear from people who enjoy film! If you feel like you are missing some of the hard skills, don’t worry, we are hiring for the attitude, values, and personality. 
     
    If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:
     
    - A company culture that really works
    - Audience as a Service
    - Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog

    How to apply

    Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.

    Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.

    If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.

    Research shows women apply when meeting 100% qualifications, men at 60%. JustWatch welcomes all candidates, especially women and marginalized groups. Apply, let's talk and explore if you're a great fit.

Senior Manager (m/w/d) - Finance Integration

Als Senior Manager (m/w/d) - Finance Integration übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion. Dabei entwickelst du unsere Finance-Organisation gezielt weiter: Du koordinierst Finance-Projekte, begleitest die Integration neuer Gesellschaften, harmonisierst Prozesse und schaffst die Grundlage für eine skalierbare Finance-Plattform. Dafür brauchen wir deine Unterstützung!


Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 48 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Finance Integration & Projektmanagement:

    • Management der Finanzintegration neuer Tochtergesellschaften im Rahmen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie.

    • Steuerung und Koordination gruppenweiter Finance-Projekte und Integrationsinitiativen.

    • Begleitung unserer Tochtergesellschaften bei der Einführung und Umsetzung gruppenweiter Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Systeme

    • Nachverfolgung von Maßnahmen, Sicherstellung der Projektfortschritte sowie aktives Eskalationsmanagement.

  • Zusammenarbeit & Standardisierung:

    • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem VP Finance Operations, unserer Director FP&A, unserem CFO sowie den Geschäftsführern und Finance-Teams unserer Tochtergesellschaften.

    • Unterstützung bei der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung von Finance-Standards, Prozesse und Reporting-Strukturen.

    • Koordination zwischen Group Accounting, Group Controlling / FP&A und den lokalen Gesellschaften.

    • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Optimierungspotenzialen innerhalb unserer Finance-Landschaft.


Deine Startvoraussetzungen

  • Das bringst Du mit:

    • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Finance-Umfeld mit fundiertem Verständnis von Accounting- und/oder Controlling-Prozessen

    • Erfahrung in der Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Projekte sowie im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern; Erfahrung in Finance Transformation, Finance Excellence, CFO-Office oder Consulting ist von Vorteil

    • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeit sowie Freude daran, Veränderungen aktiv zu begleiten und unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenbringen

    • Strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse; Erfahrungen im Bereich Post-Merger-Integration (PMI) oder in eine PE-backed bzw. wachstumsstarken Unternehmensumfeld sind von Vorteil

Unsere Benefits

  • Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, Heiligabend und Silvester jeweils einen halben Tag frei, ein hybrides Setup mit einem Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche sowie ein zentral gelegenes Office im Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, unmittelbar an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“.

  • Starke Teamkultur: Eine offene und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Stand-ups, monatlichen All-Hands Meetings und gemeinsamen Events zur Förderung einer positiven und kollegialen Arbeitsatmosphäre.

  • Direkte Nähe zur Finance-Führung und zum Business: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem VP Finance, dem CFO sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und unterstützt aktiv den Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform: Du gestaltest Prozesse, Strukturen und strategische Initiativen in einer krisensicheren, rasant wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe aktiv mit und erhältst Einblicke in die Umsetzung einer Roll-up-Strategie – unterstützt durch einen der weltweit führenden Investoren, Warburg Pincus.

  • Einblicke in die Finance-Transformation einer PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe: Von der Integration neuer Gesellschaften über die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Systemen bis hin zu Reporting-, Governance- und Skalierungsprojekten wirkst du an zentralen Finance-Initiativen unserer Buy-&-Build-Strategie mit.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess

Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung über unser Stellenportal. Nach der Prüfung Deines CVs wartet ein dreistufiger Bewerbungsprozess auf dich. Dieser startet mit einem kurzen Telefonat mit Allen, Senior Group Talent Acquisition Partner, gefolgt von einem Video-Call mit dem Fachbereich. Anschließend besteht die Möglichkeit, das Team sowie die verschiedenen Aufgaben und Verantwortungsbereiche der Stelle vor Ort besser kennenzulernen. Werde Teil unserer spannenden Reise!

We're looking for a Security & Trust Specialist to join Pencil at a pivotal moment of growth. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role who is now building a career in security. You'll own the day-to-day security operations that keep Pencil safe — endpoints, identity and access, cloud and SaaS security — and you're happy to lend a hand with practical IT and device issues where needed. You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Trust, who will support your growth into the audit, compliance and vendor-risk side of the role over time.

Key responsibilities:

  • Administer and secure endpoints (MDM/Intune, patching, encryption, device compliance), and be willing to pitch in on practical desktop support and device issues when the team needs a hand.

  • Own day-to-day identity and access management — joiner/mover/leaver processes, least-privilege access and quarterly access reviews across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GCP and other SaaS tools.

  • Monitor security alerts and logs, escalate promptly, and help investigate and document security events (suspicious logins, compromised credentials, device loss, cloud misconfiguration).

  • Support compliance evidence collection in Vanta for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, working alongside the Head of Security & Trust rather than owning audit strategy yourself.

  • Help gather evidence for vendor and customer security questionnaires, and flag anything that needs escalating.

  • Identify and implement practical improvements to monitoring, alerting and access control across cloud and endpoint tooling.

Your background:

  • A background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role, now moving into (or already doing blended IT/security) work.

  • Hands-on experience with endpoint management (Intune or similar MDM) and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration.

  • Comfortable with cloud basics (GCP, AWS or Azure IAM) — you don't need deep cloud engineering experience, but you're curious and capable of learning fast.

  • Some exposure to compliance or audit evidence gathering (Vanta or similar) is a bonus, not required.

  • A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity or Microsoft SC-900 — or clear evidence of self-directed learning if you don't have one yet.

  • A genuinely helpful, practical approach — you don't mind switching between security work and helping a colleague with their laptop.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • You enjoy being hands-on and don't mind switching between strategic security work and practical, in-the-moment IT problems (Human).

  • You're hungry to grow a career in security and want to learn from the audits and questionnaires you'll be exposed to (Owners).

  • You take ownership of problems end-to-end and don't wait to be told what to do (Owners).

  • You can explain technical issues simply to non-technical colleagues (Simple).

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We’re called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group’s mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. title: Senior Manager, Customer Success
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Success to lead our UKI team within the Large and High Growth segment. Joining our Customer Experience department, you will be responsible for executing our regional CS strategy, driving team performance, and ensuring an exceptional experience for our most strategic UKI customers.

In this role, you will directly manage, coach, and scale a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Your mission is to operationalise our customer success motions, ensuring your team successfully drives product adoption, value realisation, retention, and expansion across their portfolios.

This role is ideal for an experienced B2B SaaS or Fintech people leader who thrives in fast-paced environments. You should bring a strong execution discipline, a commercial mindset, and a passion for frontline coaching to help your team turn complex customer challenges into simple, impactful solutions.

 

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director, Customer Success (large and high growth) and leading a dedicated regional team of CSMs. The team is highly collaborative and dedicated to retain the largest customers of Pleo. You’ll also have the chance to work closely with UKI commercial team, account managers, customer support, onboarding, product and RevOps to ensure customer risk is addressed early and growth opportunities are maximised

 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Manager of Customer Success, you will:

  • Lead and coach a team of 10 CSMs, providing active coaching, career development, and daily operational guidance to ensure consistent, high-quality performance.

  • Own your team’s core metrics.

  • Implement and iterate on segment-specific success plans, engagement motions, renewal readiness playbooks, and risk-mitigation strategies.

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure seamless customer transitions, aligned account strategies, and coordinated execution during renewals and expansion plays.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for UKI strategic accounts, working cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Operations to eliminate friction points.

  • Use operational insights, data dashboards, and forecasting metrics to track team productivity, evaluate portfolio health, and proactively address churn risks.

Immediate priorities you can expect to tackle:

  • Strengthening localised account health visibility and proactive risk intervention.

  • Building high-impact execution habits across your team of 10 CSMs.

  • Improving renewal readiness and commercial handoffs with the UKI Sales teams.

  • Fostering a culture of accountability, continuous feedback, and performance excellence.

 

What You Bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, with a proven track record of 2+ years directly managing high-performing teams in B2B SaaS, fintech, or fast-paced technology environments.

  • Strong experience supporting large, mid-market, or enterprise-level accounts with complex stakeholders and sophisticated commercial needs.

  • A strong commercial acumen - you seamlessly connect day-to-day customer health to retention, expansion, and long-term business value.

  • Deep familiarity with Customer Success methodologies, customer lifecycles, health scoring, and risk mitigation tools.

  • Excellent people leadership skills with a proven ability to hire, inspire, hold accountable, and develop talent.

  • A data-driven approach, comfortable utilising CRM and CS tooling (e.g.Hubspot, Vitally) to drive team performance and forecasting.

  • Fluency in English with exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Other languages are a plus

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience in fintech, spend management, payments, or financial operations verticals.

  • Experience scaling team structures from smaller cohorts to larger regional pods.

 

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love combining frontline coaching with commercial strategy

  • You thrive in high-velocity, evolving environment

  • You want to make a highly visible, regional impact

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer a steady, predictable corporate routine

  • You want to step away from the frontline

  • You view Customer Success as purely “customer happiness"

 

How You’ll Develop in this Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Establish a highly cohesive, high-performing UKI CS team structure for our CSMs.

  • Deliver measurable improvements in UKI customer retention, renewal execution, and expansion pipelines.

  • Build a deep understanding of our product ecosystem to successfully advocate for the needs of our UKI market.

  • Be recognized as a vital execution partner to our Director of CS and a champion for our large and high-growth customer base.

 

Location

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

 

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 mins interview with the hiring manager to deep dive into your experience and what you can bring to the team

  3. Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take-home test to showcase your onboarding strategy and data driven approach and invite you to a 60 mins team interview to present your challenge and to know part of the team

  4. Final Interview: Final conversation with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Manager, Customer Success, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Highlight the most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

description:
About the Role

The head of EMEA Refund Fraud will lead Doordash’s EMEA strategy for preventing and managing refund abuse across our marketplace.

You will be accountable for the performance of the Credit and Refund (C&R) Fraud domain: setting the long-term vision, determining where we focus our resources, and building the team, controls and capabilities required to reduce fraud sustainably while protecting the experience of genuine customers.

This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of Integrity, Customer Care, Product, Engineering, Analytics and Finance. You will lead a team of experienced fraud and strategy professionals and work with senior leaders across Deliveroo to make complex decisions about fraud risk, customer experience, operational cost and product investment.

You will need to be comfortable operating in ambiguity, identifying problems before they become material, and turning complex and sometimes incomplete signals into a clear strategy. Success will come not from personally solving every problem, but from creating the direction, operating mechanisms and team that enable Deliveroo to manage refund fraud effectively at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing

  1. Setting the C&R Fraud Strategy

    • Set and own the 1–2 year vision and strategy for C&R Fraud, translating wider Integrity and business priorities into a focused roadmap.

    • Proactively identify emerging risks, systemic vulnerabilities and opportunities rather than waiting for problems to be assigned.

    • Determine the highest-value problems for the team to solve and make clear choices about where we should (and should not) invest.

    • Define how we balance fraud loss, customer experience, operational cost and growth when designing controls.

    • Build compelling business cases for significant product, policy and operational investments.

  2. Owning Performance and Risk

    • Be accountable for C&R Fraud performance and establish a clear set of outcomes, targets and guardrails.

    • Develop a comprehensive view of fraud exposure, including fraud cost, abuse rates, loss per order, false positives, customer impact and operational cost.

    • Partner with Finance and senior leadership to quantify financial exposure and inform risk appetite decisions.

    • Establish mechanisms to identify material changes in performance, understand their drivers and ensure effective action is taken.

    • Ensure the organisation can detect and respond quickly to new abuse patterns and emerging threats.

  3. Build Scalable Fraud Prevention Capabilities

    • Own the effectiveness of the overall C&R fraud framework across customer and partner journeys.

    • Identify systemic control gaps and ensure the right preventative, detective and responsive controls are in place.

    • Set the direction for product decisioning, eligibility logic, automation, friction, policies and operational interventions.

    • Ensure rules, models and controls are continually evaluated against both fraud outcomes and customer-experience guardrails.

    • Create effective feedback loops between frontline investigations, Analytics, Product and Engineering so that new insights translate into better prevention.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
Tangible is a fast-growing, tech-driven platform providing liquidity solutions to LPs in the private markets. We combine deep sector expertise with modern infrastructure to unlock liquidity across private equity, private credit, and real assets.

As we scale, we are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to build and manage the infrastructure that connects our marketing activity with sales. This is a hands-on role focused on making HubSpot a powerful operating system for understanding contact engagement, identifying intent signals, delivering relevant nurture, and helping our sales team engage the right people at the right time.

This is not an inbound lead-generation or MQL-focused role. The objective is to understand how contacts are engaging with Tangible over time — what they are reading, which campaigns they respond to, what they do on our website, and other relevant signals — so that we can identify increasing levels of interest and act quickly.

You will own the day-to-day marketing operations architecture in HubSpot, while also managing nurture campaigns, marketing messaging and the operational side of content. You will work closely with leadership and Sales to ensure our marketing activity generates useful signals and actionable intelligence, rather than simply producing more leads.

Tasks

HubSpot & Marketing Operations

  • Own and manage Tangible's HubSpot marketing operations architecture.
  • Build, maintain and optimise HubSpot workflows, properties, lists, segmentation, campaigns and automation.
  • Ensure HubSpot is correctly structured to capture and connect engagement data across marketing channels.
  • Develop robust processes for tracking contact engagement across email, website activity, content consumption, campaigns and other relevant touchpoints.
  • Maintain data quality, contact lifecycle processes and the overall integrity of the marketing database.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the way HubSpot supports Marketing and Sales as the business scales.
  • Ensure marketing activity is properly tracked and connected to the CRM so engagement can be understood at an individual contact level.

Engagement Scoring & Intent Signals

  • Build and continuously refine contact engagement scoring based on meaningful behavioural signals.
  • Develop scoring models that help us understand when an existing contact is becoming more engaged or showing increased intent.
  • Combine signals such as content engagement, website activity, email interactions, campaign participation and other relevant behaviours.
  • Use scoring to help Sales identify who is becoming more engaged and who should be contacted sooner.
  • Continuously test and refine scoring logic based on what actually proves useful to Sales.
  • Clearly communicate engagement signals and changes in contact behaviour to the sales team.
  • Ensure scoring is used as a prioritisation and intelligence tool, rather than simply as an inbound lead/MQL qualification model.

Nurture & Marketing Automation

  • Design, build and manage nurture programmes in HubSpot.
  • Develop segmented nurture journeys based on audience, interests, engagement and stage of relationship.
  • Manage the messaging, sequencing and logic behind automated campaigns.
  • Test subject lines, messaging, timing, segmentation and calls to action to improve engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to move contacts between different nurture journeys based on their behaviour.
  • Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimise programmes based on engagement and commercial outcomes.

Messaging & Sales Enablement

  • Work closely with Sales to understand the messaging and information they need to engage prospects effectively.
  • Develop and manage marketing messaging for nurture campaigns, email campaigns and other targeted communications.
  • Support Sales with relevant outreach messaging, follow-ups, campaign assets and other enablement materials.
  • Use engagement data and audience behaviour to inform messaging and help Sales personalise outreach.
  • Help Sales understand how to interpret and act on engagement signals coming from HubSpot.
  • Identify content and messaging that can support specific sales conversations and commercial priorities.

Content Operations
Content is not the primary responsibility of this role. Instead, you will ensure that Tangible's content is properly integrated into our marketing operations infrastructure.

  • Ensure content assets, reports, newsletters and other marketing activity are properly connected to HubSpot.
  • Make sure content engagement can be tracked at the contact level and incorporated into relevant segmentation and scoring.
  • Work with the wider team to ensure campaigns and content launches are set up correctly from an operational perspective.
  • Identify opportunities to use existing content within nurture programmes and sales journeys.
  • Report on which content is generating meaningful engagement and signals of interest.

Reporting & Optimisation

  • Build clear reporting around contact engagement, campaign performance, nurture activity and sales signals.
  • Provide leadership and Sales with actionable insight rather than vanity metrics.
  • Identify patterns in contact behaviour and engagement that can inform marketing and sales activity.
  • Measure the effectiveness of nurture programmes, scoring models and marketing campaigns.
  • Continuously improve the marketing operations infrastructure based on data, feedback and commercial outcomes.

Strategic Collaboration

  • Work closely with leadership and Sales to align marketing operations with commercial priorities.
  • Partner with Sales to ensure engagement signals are genuinely useful in day-to-day prospecting and relationship management.
  • Help establish the processes and infrastructure required as Tangible's marketing and sales activity scales.
  • Act as the internal owner and subject-matter expert for HubSpot marketing operations.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years' experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, CRM, lifecycle marketing or a closely related B2B marketing role.
  • Strong hands-on experience implementing and managing HubSpot architecture. This is a must-have.
  • Demonstrable experience building and managing HubSpot workflows, properties, lists, segmentation, campaigns and automation.
  • Experience designing and managing engagement or behavioural scoring models.
  • A strong understanding of how behavioural signals can be used to prioritise contacts and improve Sales engagement.
  • Experience building and optimising nurture campaigns and automated customer/prospect journeys.
  • Comfortable working across Marketing and Sales and translating commercial requirements into practical marketing-operations solutions.
  • Strong understanding of contact data, segmentation, lifecycle management and CRM hygiene.
  • Able to analyse engagement data and turn it into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong copywriting and messaging skills, particularly for B2B audiences and nurture campaigns.
  • Commercially minded, with an understanding that marketing operations should ultimately help Sales have better conversations with the right people.
  • Highly organised, analytical and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable owning the function independently and building processes from the ground up.
  • Experience in private markets, PE/VC, financial services or another complex B2B environment is preferred.

What You'll Own

This is a hands-on role with genuine ownership. You will be responsible for making sure Tangible's marketing infrastructure works properly — from the underlying HubSpot architecture through to scoring, segmentation, nurture and the signals delivered to Sales.

The ideal person is someone who enjoys building systems, understanding how people behave, and turning data into action. You should be equally comfortable getting deep into a HubSpot workflow and working with Sales on how a particular engagement signal should change their approach.

You will have the opportunity to build the marketing operations function as Tangible scales, with significant ownership over the systems, processes and programmes that connect marketing activity to revenue.

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the Team

The Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team at Airwallex is a strategically vital function operating under a clear Three Lines of Defence model. As the independent second line, FCC owns the global AML/CTF programme, sanctions framework, risk assessment methodology, and governance infrastructure across all global entities. As Airwallex scales into new markets and deepens its engagement with global regulatory bodies, we are building a world-class compliance organization capable of managing complex financial crime risks at scale. This is an environment where you will tackle high-impact challenges, shape global fintech risk strategies, and help establish foundations for long-term growth.

What you'll do

As Manager, FCC Monitoring & Testing, EMEA you will shape and scale Airwallex’s global financial crime compliance monitoring and testing framework, establishing a rigorous, data-driven second-line assurance function. You will independently validate the design and operating effectiveness of AML, Sanctions, and KYC/KYB controls across all production environments and establish a monitoring framework and associated metrics to support executive decisioning and ongoing maintenance of program and control operating effectiveness. You will work closely with the broader FCC organization, Product, Engineering, Operations, and regional leadership to turn testing insights into operational accountability, robust remediation, and a defensible compliance posture before global regulators and institutional banking partners.

This role covers the APAC region (excluding China and Hong Kong) and is based in Singapore. In this role, you will be a key part of a global team, collaborating closely across regions to drive consistent FCC Monitoring & Testing standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the strategic development, execution, and continuous evolution of Airwallex’s Global FCC Monitoring & Testing Programme, establishing robust, risk-based testing methodologies and annual plans for independent second-line assurance.

  • Design comprehensive testing frameworks to validate core compliance controls across customer onboarding, periodic reviews, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and regulatory reporting workflows, ensuring coverage keeps pace with product and market expansion.

  • Oversee the ongoing FCC monitoring program for APAC (excluding China and Hong Kong), including establishment of KPIs and operating effectiveness metrics.

  • Advance the transition from traditional sample reviews toward continuous, data-enabled assurance by leveraging data analytics, system logs, and automated testing scripts to evaluate compliance control performance at the population level.

  • Oversee the independent validation of system-encoded controls, including transaction monitoring thresholds, screening logic, and customer risk-rating models, ensuring systems function as intended without logic drift or hidden control gaps.

  • Translate complex testing outcomes and thematic trends into clear, decision-useful reporting for executive leadership and governance forums, providing constructive challenge to stakeholders and tracking the root-cause remediation of control deficiencies.

  • Represent the FCC monitoring and testing function during regulatory examinations, internal or external audits, and banking partner reviews, confidently defending testing methodologies and control evidence.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Law, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related quantitative/analytical discipline.

  • CAMS certification or an ICA International Diploma in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (or equivalent professional credential).

  • 7+ years of experience within FCC quality assurance, compliance monitoring, internal audit, or a related second/third-line control function inside a fintech, payments, or highly regulated banking environment.

  • Strong technical knowledge of financial crime controls across transaction monitoring, sanctions/PEP screening, customer due diligence, and digital KYC/KYB workflows.

  • Proven mastery of risk-based testing methodologies, including scoping, sampling, design and operating effectiveness assessments, issue writing, and remediation validation.

  • A high-ownership, pragmatic approach, with excellent written communication and stakeholder management skills to challenge senior partners constructively and drive operational accountability.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Advanced degree such as an MBA, Master’s in Regulatory Compliance, Risk Management, or a related field.

  • Professional assurance or audit certifications such as CAMS-Audit, CISA, or CIA.

  • Strong fintech and platforms experience, including exposure to cloud-native, API-driven, high-growth global environments with significant cross-border transaction volume.

  • Strong data literacy, including comfort using SQL, Python, BI dashboards, or automated tools to support continuous control validation and population-based testing.

  • Experience partnering directly with Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams to validate automated rules, model-driven controls, and rapid deployments within an agile product lifecycle.

Recruiting at Siena is owned, not handed off. You'll stay close to the candidate, close to the Talent Ops Manager, and close to the tools that run the work, so nothing gets lost between hand-offs.

  • Inbound triage and first-round screens across our highest-volume and highest-stakes roles

  • You want a fully scoped queue and clear instructions before you'll act. This role runs on judgment, not a checklist.

  • You think candidate feedback is optional once someone's a no. Here, it's the standard the whole function is built around.

  • You're waiting for the next direction before you'll take real ownership. The ownership is yours, just check on alignment

  • You want to skip the AI tooling and do things the old way because it's familiar. That's not on the table here.

  • You're looking for a pure headhunting or closing role. This is the operational and candidate-experience layer, and it's just as demanding.

  • You need a manager checking your work daily to feel confident it's right. You'll be trusted to run this, and expected to flag it yourself when something's off.

The deal

Six-month fixed-term contract, with potential to transition to a permanent role at the end of the term based on performance and business need

Why Siena?

  • Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

  • Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

  • A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback—both giving and receiving it—because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.


Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

title: Product Engineer — Working Student
description:
Working Student - Product Engineer

Over 4 million merchants use our card readers to process payments in 34 countries. As we build a world where every business can thrive, we continually expand our range of products and services. We are a truly global fintech company, with 3,000+ people from 93 nationalities spread across 22 offices on four continents.

As the People Tech team, our mission is to enable long-term scalability by fostering a data-informed culture through seamless systems and a people-centric employee experience. As our Product Engineer - Working Student, your first mission will be to help us rethink Feedback and Team Reviews: learn how the process works today, find the friction and turn promising ideas into product experiences that colleagues can test.

The work starts frontend-first: build realistic prototypes in React, Next.js or similar and explore a simpler product layer over Workday, our system of record. If a direction proves valuable, you may help grow it into a standalone internal app - from interface and APIs to data models, authentication and integrations - alongside People Tech and engineering partners.

This is a real product challenge, not a side quest: you will learn across discovery, UX, frontend, testing and product decisions, supported by mentorship and code review. You will collaborate with Product Owners, process owners, people tech and workday specialists, sumuppers, managers, people partners, people analytics and senior stakeholders, with potential exposure to backend development, integrations and production delivery. If your favourite way to answer "what if?" is to build it, you will fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Find the right problem: Speak with process owners, employees and managers to understand Feedback and Team Reviews, identify friction and decide what is worth solving first.
  • Shape a focused product slice: Turn requirements, questions and constraints into clear user journeys and an MVP that can teach us something useful.
  • Prototype and iterate quickly: Build realistic frontend experiences in React, Next.js or similar; compare directions, test assumptions and adjust when the evidence points somewhere better.
  • Design for different kinds of work:  Create accessible, intuitive flows for office-based teams, metrics-driven Field Sales colleagues and on-site teams without building three separate products.
  • Think end to end:  If the concept is validated, help evolve it towards a standalone app while considering APIs, data, authentication, privacy, deployment, integrations and what should remain in Workday.
  • Use AI as a co-pilot, not an alibi:  Use tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, v0, Lovable or similar to accelerate development while still understanding, checking and owning the result.
  • Make the learning visible: Demo your work, explain decisions and trade-offs, respond to feedback and document the findings and technical choices that should shape the next version.

You'll be great for this role if

  • Student status. You are currently enrolled at a university and available for a part-time role based in Berlin.
  • Modern web development skills. You have built web applications with React, Next.js or a similar frontend framework. Coursework, internships, hackathons, personal projects and portfolio work all count.
  • Product-minded builder. You care about the user's goal and accessibility, and can turn an ambiguous problem into the simplest useful solution, test it and iterate.
  • Full-stack and AI curiosity. You want to learn how APIs, data and services turn an interface into a reliable product, and can use AI-assisted tools while still understanding, checking and owning the result.
  • Clear, team-first communication. You can explain what you built end to end, make technical choices understandable, ask for input and respond well to feedback.

Nice to have

  • Backend and integration foundations. Some experience with Node.js, TypeScript, Python, databases, APIs, serverless functions, Supabase, Firebase, AWS or comparable technologies.
  • Identity and data concepts. A basic understanding of OAuth, SSO, permissions or responsible data handling.
  • What we don't expect: years of professional experience, previous Workday knowledge or a perfect first attempt. If you do not tick every box, please apply anyway and show us what you can build, how you think and how you learn.

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

Berlin-Adlershof – Hybrid (max. 2 Tage Homeoffice/Woche), 30+3 Urlaubstage

title: Founding Engineer / Head of Technology (m/w/d)
description:
Wer wir sind

Wir sind das Nationale Herz-Netz, kurz NHN – eine neu gegründete gemeinnützige GmbH (gGmbH) mit Sitz in Düsseldorf und 100-%ige Tochter der Deutschen Gesellschaft für Kardiologie (DGK).

Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen sind in Deutschland die häufigste Todesursache und sie verursachen mit 64 Milliarden Euro jährlich immense Kosten im Gesundheitssystem. Es wird also schnell klar: Intensive Forschung an Behandlungsoptionen rettet Leben und spart Geld. Umso erstaunlicher ist, dass die Dokumentation einer Behandlung an der Kliniktür endet. Das behandelnde Krankenhaus hat keinerlei Informationen darüber, wie es den Patienten nach der Behandlung ergeht, weiß also nicht, ob die Behandlung erfolgreich oder überflüssig war. Das sieht nur die Hausärzte oder die Kardiologen vor Ort. Ein Datenaustausch findet nicht statt.

Unser Ziel ist es, diese Lücke zu schließen: Wir bauen das erste bundesweite digitale Register für Herz-Kreislauf-Behandlungen auf: Das heißt: alle Informationen an einem Ort. Das ist jetzt möglich, weil wir mit modernster KI-Technologie in Kombination mit medizinischer Spitzenkompetenz in der Lage sind, unterschiedlichste Datenquellen zu vereinheitlichen. Durch das NHN können Ärzte erkennen, wie Therapien unter realen Bedingungen wirken – und Behandlungen dorthin lenken, wo sie tatsächlich den größten Nutzen bringen, sodass Menschen mit Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen eine messbar bessere Versorgung erhalten und länger und mit höherer Lebensqualität leben können.

Wir stehen ganz am Anfang. Du steigst zu dem Zeitpunkt ein, an dem noch alles gestaltet wird – die Prozesse, die Kultur, das Wie unserer Arbeit. Was heute entsteht, wird die deutsche Herzmedizin für viele Jahre mitprägen – und Du kannst dabei sein.

Aufgaben

Du baust die technische Plattform des NHN, rekrutierst und führst das Tech-Team.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Datenplattform, bestehend aus Backend und Frontend.
  • Du baust die KI-gestützte Extraktion auf, also die Pipelines, die aus unstrukturierten klinischen Dokumenten strukturierte medizinische Daten machen. OCR, NLP und moderne Sprachmodelle gehören dazu, ebenso die Prüfung und Freigabe durch medizinisches Personal. An der Qualität dieser Pipeline entscheidet sich der Erfolg des gesamten Vorhabens.
  • Du sorgst für Interoperabilität, indem Du konsequent auf Standards wie FHIR, HL7 und IHE setzt. So bleiben unsere Daten national wie international anschlussfähig.
  • Du denkst Datenschutz und Sicherheit von Beginn an mit: Privacy by Design, Pseudonymisierung über eine unabhängige Treuhandstelle und die Vorbereitung auf ISO 27001. Die regulatorische Verantwortung trägt unser Head of Legal, mit dem Du eng zusammenarbeitest.
  • Du triffst pragmatische Technologieentscheidungen mit Blick auf Robustheit, Auditierbarkeit und Tempo. Dabei weißt Du, welche Weichen später teuer zu stellen sind und welche man ohne Risiko wieder ändern kann.
  • Du baust das Team auf, zuerst die ersten Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler und ML-Engineers, dann die Struktur dahinter. Externe Partner bindest Du dort ein, wo sie uns schneller machen, ohne dass wir die Kernkomponenten aus der Hand geben.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast komplexe Datenplattformen entworfen und skaliert, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen oder in einem anderen stark regulierten Umfeld wie FinTech oder Cybersecurity.
  • Du arbeitest ausgesprochen hands-on: Cloud-native Softwareentwicklung und moderne Web-Technologien liegen Dir ebenso wie ML-Entwicklung und MLOps bis hin zum Finetuning großer Transformer-Modelle.
  • Du hast schon einmal etwas von Grund auf gebaut, ohne bestehende Plattform und ohne großes Team im Rücken.
  • Du verbindest technische Vision mit pragmatischer Umsetzung und priorisierst eine Roadmap so, dass früh etwas Lauffähiges existiert.
  • Kenntnisse von Interoperabilitätsstandards und medizinischen Terminologien sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Die medizinische Fachlichkeit kommt aus unserem ärztlichen Team.
  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, agile Teams aufzubauen und die Balance zwischen eigener Entwicklung und externen Partnern zu halten.
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse mit, denn unsere Partner sind deutsche Kliniken.

Benefits

  • Arbeit mit echtem gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert: Die Technologie, die Du baust, soll in zwei Jahren in über 60 Kliniken produktiv laufen. Wir treten an, um einen Beitrag zu einem besseren Gesundheitswesen zu leisten, nicht um für Anteilseigner Rendite zu erwirtschaften.
  • Sicheres Umfeld, gesicherte Finanzierung: Als Tochter der Deutschen Gesellschaft für Kardiologie (DGK) stehen wir auf einem verlässlichen Fundament. Unsere Finanzierung ist langfristig gesichert. Du bekommst die Aufbaudynamik einer jungen Organisation ohne das übliche Start-up-Risiko.

title: Go-to-Market Engineer – AI & Automation (m/f/d)
description:
Dein Impact

autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe. As we scale, we want our Go-to-Market organization to operate with the same level of automation, data quality, and product thinking as our engineering organization.


As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you will own the technical infrastructure behind our revenue engine.


You will work directly with our Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Product teams to identify bottlenecks, build internal tools, automate workflows, connect systems, and deploy AI where it creates measurable commercial impact.


This is not a traditional RevOps or analytics role.


We are looking for a builder who can understand a commercial problem in the morning and start shipping a solution in the afternoon. You will combine software engineering, automation, AI, data, and commercial thinking to make our GTM organization faster and more effective.


You will have significant ownership over how autarc builds its GTM infrastructure as we scale across Europe.


Role description

What You’ll Do

Build our GTM operating system

Own and continuously improve the systems powering our entire customer lifecycle – from first lead to closed customer and expansion.

Build internal applications and workflows that help SDRs, Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and leadership make better decisions and execute faster.

Turn fragmented processes into scalable systems.


Automate the revenue engine

Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success and automate them.

Build automations for areas such as lead enrichment, routing, qualification, follow-ups, pipeline management, customer onboarding, and retention.

Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems.


Deploy AI into real workflows

Move AI beyond prototypes.

Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work.

Experiment rapidly with new models and tools and turn successful experiments into reliable internal products.


Own GTM data & analytics

Create a reliable data foundation for our commercial organization.

Connect and structure data across our CRM, calling infrastructure, product, billing, and other GTM systems.

Build dashboards and internal tools that give teams real-time visibility into the metrics that matter: pipeline, activity, conversion, ARR, retention, and individual and team performance.

Make sure we can answer important commercial questions with data rather than assumptions.


Build, don’t just recommend

You will personally implement what you design.

Depending on the problem, that might mean writing Python or TypeScript, building an n8n workflow, connecting an API, querying a database, prototyping an internal application, or working with our engineers on a deeper integration.

You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation.


Drive measurable commercial impact

Technology is a means, not the outcome.

Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result.


Requirements

  • You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better.

  • You have strong technical skills and can independently ship solutions using Python and/or TypeScript.

  • You have hands-on experience building automations and integrations using tools such as n8n and APIs.

  • You understand modern AI tooling and have already built applications or workflows using LLMs.

  • You are comfortable working with databases, APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines.

  • You understand how modern B2B SaaS companies generate revenue and are interested in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the systems connecting them.

  • You can translate an ambiguous business problem into a technical solution without needing a detailed specification.

  • You prioritize commercial impact over technical perfection.

  • You move fast, iterate, and are comfortable shipping a first version before everything is perfect.

  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You are fluent in English. German or another European language is a plus


Bonus Points

  • You have previously worked as a GTM Engineer, Growth Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, RevOps Engineer, or in a similarly hands-on technical role.

  • You have experience with B2B SaaS GTM stacks and tools such as HubSpot, Aircall, Stripe, Intercom, PostHog, or similar platforms.

  • You have built internal tools, AI agents, lead-scoring systems, enrichment pipelines, or automated outbound workflows.

  • You understand data modeling and have experience building a data warehouse or analytics infrastructure.

  • You have worked in an early-stage or high-growth startup where speed and ownership mattered more than clearly defined responsibilities.


Was wir bieten

A high-ownership role with direct influence on how autarc scales its commercial organization.

The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure from the ground up instead of maintaining legacy systems.

Direct collaboration with our founders and GTM leadership.

A fast-moving environment where you can ship and test ideas quickly.

A strong engineering and product culture combined with an ambitious commercial organization.

A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person.

MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work.

Most importantly: a role where your output can directly influence how quickly autarc grows


Unsere Werte

Why autarc?

autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers.

Our platform helps installers manage the entire workflow around renewable energy projects – from lead and site assessment to technical planning, offers, documentation, installation, and ongoing operations.

We already serve more than 2,000 businesses and are expanding our platform across Europe.

As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you won’t inherit a finished system. You will help design the next generation of our commercial infrastructure.

You will work directly with leadership, have access to the entire GTM organization, and be able to ship solutions that are used by the team immediately.

No endless strategy decks. No six-month implementation projects.

Find the bottleneck. Build the solution. Measure whether it worked. Improve it.

Eine Wahrheit, nicht fünf

Lovebetter wächst.

Unser bisheriger COO zieht sich bewusst aus dem operativen Tagesgeschäft zurück, um neue Wachstumsprojekte voranzutreiben. Das operative Herz des Unternehmens braucht deshalb eine neue Instanz mit voller Verantwortung, klarem Blick und echter Entscheidungskraft.

Diese Rolle ist kein Verwalterjob. Sie ist die Position, die dafür sorgt, dass das Unternehmen läuft, skaliert – oder stehen bleibt.

Wenn du einen exzellenten Job machst, wächst Lovebetter.
Wenn nicht, tut es niemand.

Wofür Lovebetter steht

Wir lösen sexuelle Probleme wie vorzeitigen Samenerguss oder Erektionsprobleme mit Männern und befähigen sie, ihre innere Stärke, sexuelle Zufriedenheit und Lebensqualität von innen heraus zu transformieren.
Unsere Arbeit wirkt weit über den Einzelnen hinaus: auf Partnerschaften, Familien und kommende Generationen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Verantwortung liebt, Wirkung über Resultate erzeugt – und weiß, dass echter Impact aus Exzellenz, Struktur und Umsetzungskraft entsteht.

Deine Mission als COO

  • Du bist der operative Geschäftsführer von Lovebetter.

  • Der Mensch, der das Gesamtunternehmen steuert, priorisiert, absichert und nach vorne bringt.

  • Du führst die Führungskräfte.

  • Du hältst die Zahlen.

  • Du triffst Entscheidungen – auch die unbequemen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Führung der Führungskräfte Head of Sales, Head of Marketing und Head of Fulfillment sowie Backoffice/Assistenz, Business Development und HR/Recruiting berichten direkt an dich. Du führst, entwickelst, forderst – und triffst Personalentscheidungen, wenn nötig.

  • Operative Gesamtsteuerung des Unternehmens Du hältst den Überblick über alle Abteilungen, KPIs, Cashflow, Kostenstrukturen und Engpässe – täglich, nicht nur im Report.

  • Zahlen, Finanzen & Entscheidungen Du verstehst komplexe Zusammenhänge – inklusive P&L, Cashflow und Forecasting –, erkennst Risiken früh und triffst unternehmerische Entscheidungen auf Basis von Fakten.

  • Strukturen, Prozesse & Skalierung Du erkennst Schwachstellen, baust klare Prozesse, reduzierst Abhängigkeiten und sorgst dafür, dass Wachstum nicht chaotisch wird.

  • Menschen & Kommunikation Du führst Mitarbeitergespräche und Gehaltsgespräche mit Fingerspitzengefühl, führst finale Hiring-Gespräche bei relevanten Rollen mit und sorgst dafür, dass Events und Webinare organisatorisch sauber laufen.

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründer Du bist Sparringspartner, Umsetzer und Realitätscheck – und sorgst dafür, dass Visionen sauber in operative Exzellenz übersetzt werden. Dein Ziel: Du nimmst der Geschäftsführung das operative Tagesgeschäft Schritt für Schritt vollständig ab.

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Echter Hebel: Deine Entscheidungen beeinflussen Umsatz, Gewinn, Team & Wachstum direkt

  • Freiheit & Verantwortung: Kein Mikromanagement – sondern klare Ergebnisverantwortung

  • Markt mit massivem Potenzial: Weitgehend unbesetzt, gesellschaftlich relevant

  • High-Performance-Kultur: Leistung, Klarheit und Ownership sind Standard

  • Gestaltungsraum: Prozesse, Strukturen und Team auf Top-Niveau formen

  • Echte Perspektive: Bei passender Entwicklung kann diese Rolle mittelfristig in Richtung CEO wachsen

Dein Impact

Wenn du deinen Job exzellent machst, entsteht:

  • ein hochprofitables, sauberes Unternehmen

  • ein leistungsstarkes, klares Team

  • nachhaltiges Wachstum ohne Chaos

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen.

Schick uns keine Standardbewerbung.
Erzähl uns lieber:

  • wo du bereits skaliert hast

  • wofür du Verantwortung getragen hast

  • und warum du glaubst, dass genau du Lovebetter operations-seitig auf das nächste Level bringst.


Wen wir suchen (und wen nicht)

Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn …

  • du mindestens 3 Jahre als COO oder Geschäftsführer gearbeitet hast

  • du bereits 20+ Mitarbeitende geführt hast – idealerweise in einem etablierten, profitablen Unternehmen (40–50+ Mitarbeitende), nicht ausschließlich im frühen Startup

  • du nachweislich Unternehmen skaliert oder stark mitentwickelt hast

  • du exzellent mit Zahlen bist und komplexe Zusammenhänge wirklich verstehst

  • du strukturiert, analytisch und entscheidungsstark arbeitest

  • du kommunikativ sattelfest bist – auch in sensiblen Mitarbeiter- und Gehaltsgesprächen

  • du persönlich einen echten Bezug zu Wachstum und Persönlichkeitsentwicklung hast – als Haltung, nicht als Buzzword

  • du unter Druck ruhig bleibst und Verantwortung nicht abgibst

  • du egoarm bist, Feedback annimmst und Klarheit über Harmonie stellst

  • du belastbar bist und auch Phasen mit hohem Workload souverän managst

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn …

  • du Zahlen „gefühlt“ statt analytisch bewertest

  • du extrem beziehungsgetrieben oder konfliktscheu bist

  • du deine eigenen Ideen ungefiltert durchdrücken willst

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) - Berlin I Germany | EU I Remote
description:
How will you make an impact?

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of engineering and product to shape how our users build with Hygraph. You'll ship features that solve real customer problems, contribute to our CMS core, extend our platform capabilities, and help bring AI-powered features to life. You won't wait for perfect specs or pixel-perfect designs. You'll use your judgment, collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and customers, and move fast using modern AI-assisted development tools.

This role is for someone who sees engineering as a team sport, takes ownership without waiting for permission, and thrives in an environment where initiative matters more than instructions.

What you will be working on:

  • Core CMS development: Evolve the GraphQL-native CMS powering enterprise teams worldwide, improving performance, reliability, and developer experience.

  • CMS extensions and integrations: Develop and maintain extensions that expand what customers can do with Hygraph.

  • AI-powered features: Contribute to our AI roadmap by building intelligent capabilities into the product.

  • Customer-facing improvements: Use monitoring data, customer feedback, and your product instinct to identify and fix problems before they're reported proactively.

Some of your tasks and responsibilities:

  • Collaborate in a cross-functional, autonomous team to deliver features and continuous improvements, often working from rough prototypes or early concepts rather than polished designs.

  • Translate business needs into technical solutions by working closely with the Product team. Occasionally, participate in customer conversations to validate that what you're building actually solves their problems.

  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex, or similar) to accelerate development.

  • Proactively identify issues through monitoring and observability data. Then fix them, don't just flag them.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions that keep our platform scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

  • Share what you know, learn from others, and help your teammates grow. Engineering here is collaborative. We win together.

Expectations timeline

1 Month

You'll complete onboarding covering our product, tech stack, infrastructure, and vision. You'll meet people across the company, get familiar with our codebase, and ship your first contributions. You'll start building context on how our customers use Hygraph and what matters most to them.

3 Months

You'll be delivering features and improvements to production with confidence. You'll have a solid understanding of Hygraph's product and architecture, and you'll be contributing ideas, not just code. You'll have built working relationships with your team lead, PMs, designers, and fellow engineers through regular 1:1s, operational reviews, and day-to-day collaboration.

6 Months

By now, you'll be making significant contributions to both the product and the team. You'll bring fresh perspectives from your experience and help raise the bar across performance, architecture, and how we work. You'll be someone the team relies on. Not because you do everything, but because you make everyone around you better.


What we expect from you:

Significant experience (typically 6+ years) building and owning production systems, with strong full-stack skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and deep backend expertise, scalability, and performance fundamentals (ideally Node.js).

  • Experience building user interfaces, ideally with React.

  • Experience developing well-tested APIs with GraphQL.

  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (especially PostgreSQL), including schema design and query optimization.

  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude, Cursor, Codex, or similar) in your workflow.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native development (AWS, GCP).

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (New Relic, Datadog, or similar).

  • Openness and experience with on-call and operational work (investigations, incident response, etc.).

  • Ability to work with ambiguity: rough prototypes, evolving requirements, and imperfect information. You use judgment and experience to fill the gaps.

  • Strong product sense. You think about why you're building something, not just how. You care about the customer experience, not just the code.

Bonus points

  • Experience with Golang.

  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code tooling (Pulumi, Terraform).

  • Experience working directly with customers or in customer-facing roles.

  • Familiarity with headless CMS platforms or content infrastructure.

The Process

  • Intro call with People Team

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Technical Interview

  • C-Level Call and Reference Check (optional)

  • Job Offer

The response time after application, screening applications, and setting up the first intro call is usually within 1-2 weeks. You could expect some alterations when necessary.

About us

Hygraph is a dynamic Berlin-based startup and a GraphQL-native, API-first headless CMS built for teams delivering complex, composable digital experiences. Hygraph is on a mission to eliminate complexity for global teams and help them scale content without friction. Our platform empowers you to create, deliver, and distribute content faster and at scale. We’re a team committed to shaping the future of AI-powered content platforms. Trusted by over 50,000 teams worldwide, Hygraph powers structured content across websites, applications, product experiences, and AI-enabled systems.

As AI reshapes how digital experiences are created and operated, Hygraph is helping organizations build on structured, trusted content foundations that enable human-first, AI-accelerated experiences at scale. You will be part of a remote-first, globally distributed team committed to working collaboratively, transparently, and passionately. We believe in a remote-first approach where everyone is encouraged to do their best from wherever they are and work together with transparency, accountability, and ownership. We learn continuously through feedback and have a yearly learning budget to attend training and conferences.

Hygraph is an equal-opportunity employer committed to hiring people with diverse backgrounds. We believe that diversity, unique experiences, qualities, and different cultures enrich our workspace's productivity and promote innovation and creativity.

Note: We are fortunate to receive a large number of applications for our roles. To manage this effectively and give each application the attention it deserves, we use AI-assisted tools to help assess certain screening questions and handle application elements. This helps us ensure a consistent and timely review process. All final hiring decisions are made exclusively by our human recruitment team.

title: Data Platform & Data Architecture Consultant
description:
About the role

As a Data Platform & Data Architecture Consultant, you are the person clients trust to turn their data infrastructure from a bottleneck into a competitive advantage. You design data landscapes, stand up and scale cloud data platforms, and set the guardrails that let entire organisations build on data safely and efficiently.

Our consultants bring varied paths and perspectives to this work. What unites them is structural thinking, a drive to understand the business context behind every technical decision, and the ability to operate across both the blueprint and the build. Across engagements, you may operate as a data architect, lead a platform build, or contribute at the strategic advisory level, often blending several of these roles within a single engagement.

 

What the work looks like

Building and operating platforms. You design, provision, and harden cloud data platforms end to end, covering storage and compute, networking, security and IAM, observability, and cost. You codify infrastructure using tools like Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation and establish governance frameworks such as data catalogs, data contracts, RBAC models, and SLAs that let organisations scale data access without losing control. You build platforms that multiple teams and business domains can rely on, not just at launch, but as they grow.

Shaping the data architecture. You design logical and physical data models, map data flows and lineage across systems, and make the structural decisions that determine how data is organised, integrated, and consumed. This can mean designing a target-state architecture for a client migrating from legacy systems to a modern cloud lakehouse, or defining domain boundaries and data product interfaces in a data mesh adoption.

Advising and translating. You sit at the intersection of technology and business. You work with data engineers, data scientists, product owners, and senior client stakeholders to understand what they need, then turn that into platform strategy and architecture decisions. You are the person a CTO trusts to make the right call on how their data infrastructure should evolve.


Minimum Qualifications
  • Master’s Degree in Engineering or Technology (e.g., Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or similar) 
  • Verbal and written fluency in English
  • 2–4 years of full-time work experience in cloud data infrastructure, data platform engineering, or data architecture. Experience working in agile product or delivery teams, gained after completing your Master's degree

title: AI Engineer (LLM/RAG) (m/w/d)
description:
For a company in the fast-growing AI implementation market we are looking for an experienced AI Engineer, starting immediately. The company operates LLM-based systems in production: content generation pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over internal documents, and automated workflows deeply integrated with their business systems. The stack is TypeScript and Next.js end to end.

These systems are already live. As AI Engineer you take ownership of them, improve their reliability and quality, and extend them to new use cases. The role combines applied LLM engineering with solid backend engineering in TypeScript. It does not involve training or fine-tuning foundation models.

Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Postgres with pgvector, Docker, Azure, Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, Vercel AI SDK.

Tasks

  • Take over and maintain the existing LLM pipelines: assess the current architecture, identify failure modes, prioritise fixes, and refactor and extend without disrupting production
  • Own the RAG systems end to end: document ingestion and parsing, chunking, indexing, hybrid retrieval (BM25 and vector), query rewriting, reranking, grounded generation with citations
  • Implement and maintain chunk-level access control, index freshness and tenant isolation across retrieval systems
  • Develop content generation pipelines that deliver consistent quality at volume, including human review steps
  • Build and operate automated workflows against internal and third-party business systems (ERP, CRM, email, internal APIs), with durable and idempotent execution, retry and dead-letter handling, and approval steps for irreversible actions
  • Establish an evaluation framework for systems currently running without one: golden datasets derived from observed production failures, retrieval metrics and more
  • Implement observability across the full request path
  • Optimise cost and latency through prompt caching, batching, model routing and use of smaller models where appropriate
  • Assess where deterministic logic is the better solution and implement it accordingly
  • Work directly with non-technical colleagues to specify and validate automated processes

Requirements

  • Professional experience with at least one LLM-based system in production use, including responsibility for its operation and incident handling
  • TypeScript and Node.js at an advanced level: strict typing of non-deterministic model output, async and concurrency patterns, streaming responses, structured error handling
  • Next.js in production: App Router, route handlers, server actions, streaming to the client
  • Practical retrieval expertise: hybrid search, embedding model selection, cross-encoder reranking, metadata filtering, permission-aware retrieval, and structured diagnosis of poor retrieval quality
  • Experience processing real-world documents: PDFs with tables, scanned material, DOCX, HTML, including layout-aware parsing, OCR and evidence-based chunking
  • Structured outputs and tool calling as part of your everyday work: JSON Schema, Zod or comparable runtime validation, function calling, handling of malformed or partial output, context window management
  • Designed and run LLM evaluations
  • Experience with LLM tracing and evaluation tooling in a TypeScript codebase (e.g. Braintrust, Langfuse, Promptfoo, OpenTelemetry or Arize Phoenix)
  • Familiar with Postgres including vector search (pgvector or a comparable vector store), Docker, Git, CI/CD and one major cloud platform
  • Working experience with the Anthropic and/or OpenAI TypeScript SDKs
  • Confident communication in English, German is a plus

If you have experience with any of the following, that's a plus:

  • durable workflow execution for long-running, unattended processes (Temporal, Inngest or comparable)
  • agent orchestration in production, tool calling, recovery, multi-step workflows (Vercel AI SDK, LangGraph, Mastra, Claude Agent SDK, MCP TypeScript SDK)
  • integration experience with enterprise systems such as ERP or CRM platforms like SAP
  • security and data protection in LLM systems, prompt injection and data exfiltration defences, PII handling, GDPR-compliant design, EU-hosted or self-hosted inference
  • structured or graph-based retrieval for entity-heavy data
  • experience migrating live pipelines to a new model, embedding model or index without quality regression
  • Azure DevOps, Pipelines, Repos and Boards

Benefits

  • Hybrid setup, 2 office days per week in the light-flooded office in the Belgian Quarter in Cologne (with two balconies and the best view over the city ;))
  • AI implementation, the growth market of the coming years
  • Trust-based working hours with overtime compensation
  • Plenty of creative freedom and room for your own ideas
  • Continuous development, professional, strategic and technological
  • An open feedback culture, transparent communication and short decision paths
  • Regular team events and workations
  • Salary from €60,000 gross per year, ofc with room upwards depending on your experience

The company is an international team and actively fosters an inclusive environment. Applications from all genders and identities are welcome, regardless of origin, age, religion, sexual orientation or disability. Women are still underrepresented in the tech industry and are explicitly encouraged to apply.

We look forward to your application!
